input.quote: Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: Section 17 addresses only our obligations on termination (ceasing use and returning/destroying Garman's Software, Documentation and Codes). There is no transition assistance, no obligation on Garman to return Sparkling's data (Section 4 covers only inbound data conversion), and no deletion/certification obligation; Section 8 return of Confidential Information applies only if the rejection option is exercised, and the Section 16 escrow is at best a partial substitute. We therefore insert a new Section 17(d) matching the preferred position (six months' assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data return within 30 days, then deletion with written certification) and add it to the survival list in Section 18.

proposal.summary: Add termination transition assistance, data return and certified deletion obligations on Garman, and confirm survival.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit: Garman provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates, returns our data and Confidential Information in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and only then deletes and certifies deletion. The Agreement currently obliges us to return Garman's materials on termination but gives us no exit help or data return, which we cannot accept; we can live with a 90-day assistance period if six months is difficult.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (i) at Sparkling's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) calendar days of Sparkling's request, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data and Confidential Information in Garman's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete or destroy all such data and Confidential Information remaining in its systems and certify such deletion in writing to Sparkling.
